fullDesc: 1.5KE400A TVS Diode – 1500W Transient Voltage Suppressor Protect your sensitive electronics from voltage spikes and transients with the 1.5KE400A TVS diode . This unidirectional transient voltage suppressor is designed to clamp dangerous overvoltage events, safeguarding circuits in power supplies, automotive electronics, industrial controls, and communication systems. Why Choose the 1.5KE400A TVS Diode? fullDesc: The BLM16N10 is not a rectifier . It is actually a power MOSFET (Metal–Oxide–Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor) — specifically an N-Channel power MOSFET . A MOSFET like the BLM16N10 is a switch device . It controls current flow between drain and source depending on gate voltage, and is used in power management and switching circuits — not as a standalone AC-to-DC converter. Typical Applications of BLM16N10 Switch-mode power supplies (SMPS) DC-DC converters Motor control circuits Battery management systems General power switching in electronics Package Included: 1x BLM16N10 MOSFET

fullDesc: The FNIRSI-DP150 is a high-performance adjustable DC power supply launched by our company. It features a Type-C input interface and multiple power supply modes, allowing precise adjustment of output voltage (0-30V) and current (0-5A). It provides efficient, low-consumption, and stable output, equipped with multiple safety protection functions including overvoltage, overcurrent, overload, overheating, and reverse connection. It can be flexibly applied to serial connection of multiple devices, with rich and user-friendly display and operation, compact and portable humanized design, meeting various application needs. It is designed to provide you with high-performance and stable CNC power supply. Specifications Brand FNIRSI Model DPS-150 Input Voltage DC 5.0V~32V Input Current 100mA-5A Input Way PD fast charger QC fast charger Power bank DC power adapters Output Voltage 0~30V Output Current 0~5A Output Power 0-150W Operating Environment 0℃-40℃ Load Regulation 0.49% Full Load Efficiency 96.30% Screen 2.8 Inch (320x240) Weight about 178g Dimensions 106x76x28mm Overvoltage Protection Support Overcurrent Protection Support Undervoltage Protection Support Overpower Protection Support Overtemperature Protection Support Reverse Input Protection Support Reverse Output Protection Support Short Circuit Protection Support Upper Computer Software Support Firmware Upgrade Support ⚠ Precautions The product operates in step-down mode, so ensure that the input voltage is higher than the output voltage The power supply range for this product is Dc 5V~30v. Output will be disabled if the input voltage is lower than 5.0V due to undervoltage lockout, and the device may be damaged if the input voltage exceeds 30V. lt is recommended to use a power supply ranging from 5V to 30V. When supplying power to inductive and capacitive loads, it is recommended to connect the load before turning on the device output. When outputting high power, some heat generation is normal. lt is recommended to use the device in a well-ventilated environment. Please remember not to connect power to both power ports of the device simultaneously, as simultaneous power supply may potentially damage the input source with lower voltage. When charging batteries, it is strongly recommended to add a reverse current protection module (such as a Schottky diode) to the output end to protect the device from damage.
